paper_id: Na et al. - 2023 - Leggiero Analog WiFi Backscatter with Payload Transparency
title: Leggiero: Analog WiFi Backscatter with Payload Transparency
motivation: Backscatter tags' μP (mW-level) wastes the ultra-low-power RF (μW-level), and existing methods corrupt WiFi carrier traffic.
problem_framing: Eliminate microprocessor as interface; embed sensor data into WiFi CSI without modifying payload or degrading carrier throughput.
key_insight: Reflection coefficient can be varied continuously in analog form; exploiting ESS feature in 802.11n lets sensor-embedded phase coexist with payload.
method_signature: Varactor-diode-based passive reflective circuit converts analog voltage to RF phase; ESS CSI carries sensor data transparently.
evaluation_criteria: Power consumption (30μW), throughput (5Kbps), WiFi carrier throughput unaffected, synchronization accuracy (250ns).
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Direct voltage switching fails due to LC transient process lasting >2μs; capacitive sensors have too-large capacitance (100pF+) yielding only 1.5° phase range.
evidence_for_taste: the reflection coefficient can not only be switched digitally but also be controlled in an analog form
using a capacitor sensor is not an option
phase difference remains always very close to 0
no modification is made to the payload
thinking_moves: 电路理论反推：refection coefficient can be varied continuously → analog control possible
否定直觉方案：先试capacitor model，发现generality和phase range/linearity问题，主动放弃
利用标准中的冗余feature：ESS本是sounding extra channel，作者借用来承载sensor data
定位工程异常的根本原因：direct voltage switching的LC transient过程导致失败
通过component-level分析找到满足power+cost+accuracy的custom方案（vs商业IC）
